fields.description: Buyer's code at the level the line is priced.

fields.description: Description as printed for this line.

fields.description: Buyer's colour code where distinct from the name.

fields.description: Size label for this line.

fields.description: Ordered quantity. Excludes 'Total Quantity' footer rows.

fields.label: UOM

fields.description: Line price. Falls back to the header base price when the override is blank.
fields.label: Unit Price

fields.label: Line Amount

fields.description: Mirrors the parent order currency so Currency fields render with the right symbol. Set automatically.

fields.description: Line-level date. Carries the drop split where an order ships in phases.

fields.description: Retail barcode where printed.

fields.description: Line-level tariff code where it varies by size or style.
fields.label: HS / HTS Code

fields.description: Colour-specific composition where the PO overrides the header default.
fields.label: Composition (line override)

fields.description: Pack or ratio code for assorted orders.
fields.label: Assortment / Pack Code

fields.description: Units per pack or carton.
fields.label: Pack / Case Lot Qty

fields.description: Number of packs or cartons on the line.
fields.label: No. of Packs / Cartons

fields.description: Domestic (India) orders only.
fields.label: Domestic

fields.description: Printed retail price.
fields.label: MRP / Retail Price

fields.label: Tax Rate %

fields.label: Tax Amount (per unit)

fields.description: Raw string or anything the parser could not map on this line.
